checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that several checkpoints (eyes, full body, legs) are untestable due to occlusion and pose. However, the Router was slightly lenient on the 'Characteristic M-shaped marking... and ringed tail' checkpoint. It marked this as 'present' because the M-marking is visible, ignoring the 'ringed tail' part which is completely out of frame. Strictly, this checkpoint is partially untestable. I will treat it as 'Present' for alignment scoring since the primary diagnostic feature (M-marking) is strongly present, but note the incompleteness.
artifact_review: The Router found no artifacts. The Perceptual Quality Auditor also found no graphics-level distortions. However, the Animal Pose Auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk with a 65% low-confidence keypoint ratio. While the Reflector instructions state to treat low confidence as a weak signal due to domain shift, the specific keypoints with low confidence include the ears and shoulders. Visually inspecting the image, the fur texture around the ears is somewhat soft and lacks the crisp strand definition seen in high-end photography, potentially indicating slight AI smoothing or 'melting' into the background. The topology mask shows a clean separation, but the boundary between the cat's head and the white sheets has a slight 'halo' or softness that isn't purely optical blur. This suggests minor generative artifacts in texture synthesis, even if structural geometry is plausible. The severity is low (1-2), not catastrophic, but present.
alignment_reasoning: The fine-grained classifier strongly confirms the class 'tabby, tabby cat' with high logit scores. The visible features (M-marking, ear shape, coat pattern) align perfectly with the taxonomy. The score is deducted slightly from 5.0 only because significant portions of the diagnostic criteria (tail, legs, eyes) are untestable due to the pose, preventing a 100% verification of all class features.
artifact_reasoning: While no gross structural failures (extra limbs, melting) are visible, the high low-confidence ratio from the pose auditor combined with the slightly 'waxy' or over-smoothed fur texture around the ears and cheeks indicates subtle AI generation artifacts. The image lacks the micro-texture complexity of a real photograph in those specific regions. The boundary is clean, but the texture integration is not perfect. This results in a good but not flawless artifact score.
key_defects: Slightly over-smoothed fur texture around ears/cheeks (AI smoothing)
Untestable diagnostic features (tail, legs, eyes) due to pose
High pose estimation uncertainty suggesting subtle anatomical ambiguity in obscured regions
